notes.title: Serious Island Update (No Drinking While Farming)
notes.content:
Big news from WoodIsland! Get ready for a hilarious adventure just a stone's throw from a certain well-known Atlantic island... ːsteamhappyː

Remember that mission to inject comedy and simplify the farm life? Well, things have taken a rather interesting turn!

[olist]
 Welcome to WoodIsland (Tutorial): Your journey begins as a tourist arriving at the port. Get your bearings and learn the ropes in this gentle introduction to island life.

 The Wilds of WoodIsland (Main Game): Once you've settled in, prepare for the "gentle" transition to the main island! No hand-holding here ːsteammockingː it's all about survival, exploration, and a lot of laughs.

 Chatty Locals and Memorable Quests: Get ready to mingle! Talk to the quirky inhabitants of WoodIsland, take on their bizarre quests, and watch as they remember your good deeds (or hilarious failures) next time you load and talk to them!

 Satisfying Snacking: Your homegrown goodness just got even better! Munching on your harvested crops now fills you up more and comes with a rather… amusing sound effect when they're ready to be picked. Trust me, you'll know. ːsteamthumbsupː

 Real Euros, Real Fun: Forget generic coins! We're dealing with cold, hard (virtual) Euros now. Time to earn that dough and build your WoodIsland empire!

 Wuant is HERE!: That's right! The YouTuber is now a playable skin in the game. Get ready to farm, explore, and cause mayhem as that guy.

[previewyoutube=jDuZWfCifQs;full][/previewyoutube]

 More Hidden Easter Eggs and Pop Culture Parodies: Keep your eyes peeled for even more subtle (and not-so-subtle) nods to internet culture, memes, and maybe even a few cheeky references to real-world games and figures.

 Improved Sound Design for Maximum Comedy: Get ready for even more hilarious sound effects accompanying every action, interaction, and unexpected event. From comical animal noises to exaggerated reactions, your ears are in for a treat.


 And So Much More!: We're talking improved gameplay, enhanced graphics, and a world brimming with funny references, hidden secrets, and unforgettable moments.
[/olist]


Don't miss the PROMOTION! Grab the game now and join the ever-growing community on WoodIsland. Your support makes this wonderfully weird project a reality!

notes.title: Gameplay Update - First Week Patch
notes.content:
ːsteamthisː Regular Update. Enhanced Controls & Visuals: ːsteamthisː


Camera Overhaul: Enjoy smooth, mouse-free camera orbiting, similar to modern third-person games.


4K Support & Options: Experience the game in stunning 4K, with new "Back to Game" functionality.


Improved Interactions: Interact with objects (imerchants, notes) simply by pressing "E". Also the mouse interaction is still available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539968/9645ef1442a63817ab51ba783f0f6b56c66eca62.jpg
This image highlights my new 'E' key interaction for easier access to items, merchants, and notes. Mouse interaction is still available.

Critical Needs Alerts: When life, food, or thirst drops to 10%, you'll receive clear audio and visual warnings (red icons) to prevent sudden depletion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539968/b12f66af0df7d6bfd6c176ac59689dc5dc85519b.jpg
On top of that, as you can see from this image, it now shows the status effects, this time is about being drunk.


Summary: Content and Bug Fixes: ːsteamhappyː

 Audio Enhancement: The main menu now dynamically manages game music, pausing and resuming for a smoother transition.
 World Correction: A previously absent house has been restored to its proper location.
 Survival Clarity: Players will receive more distinct warnings when their health approaches critical levels.
 Dialogue Control: The "E" key now allows players to skip through dialogue text.
 Visual Feedback: Status effects are now accompanied by visual indicators.
 Interaction Streamline: Notes and vendors can now be interacted with using the "E" key.
 Camera Refinement: Camera movement has been smoothed for improved player experience.
 General Stability: Numerous minor fixes have been implemented to enhance overall stability.



I will do another update in the upcoming weeks. stay tuned, keep playing, and interact. thank you. 



Little Farm Island Dev,
Diogo F.

notes.title: Update 0.9.2 - Week One Patch
notes.content:
Core Improvements:

Gameplay: Cars, Quests, Hospital, Save/Load added.
Customization: More Skin Options.
Visuals/Audio: 4K, Smooth Camera, Dynamic Clouds, Original Music.
Interaction: "E" key for Notes/Vendors.

Bug Fixes:

Axe Glitch, Garage Access, Framerate optimized.
Menu Music, Low Health Alerts, Dialogue Skip.
Status Effects, Missing House fixed.
